Guides › Higgsfield pricing

Higgsfield pricing explained

Edited by Emmanuel Gonzalez

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

Higgsfield’s current individual and business plan prices, including the 11.11 sale that ends Nov 14, 2026, 4:00 PM PT, are taken from the official pricing page today. The lowest Higgsfield plan rate already in this catalog is $0.0217/s (Wan 3.0, 480p), assuming every paid credit is used. Unlimited bonuses apply only on higgsfield.ai. Affiliate links never change this price order.

Last checked 2026-11-14.

Related: Higgsfield Black Friday 2026: what you save per second · Is Higgsfield worth it? · Unlimited Seedance 2.5 plans compared · Kling AI pricing and credits · credit calculator.

What does every Higgsfield plan cost right now?

On the official pricing page, checked Nov 13, 2026 PT, individual list prices are Starter $19/mo (monthly or annual, same price, 270 credits), Plus $59/mo (1,200 credits), and Ultra 3K $129/mo, Ultra 6K $250/mo, and Ultra 9K $375/mo (3,000 / 6,000 / 9,000 credits). The 11.11 sale is still marked active and ends Nov 14, 2026, 4:00 PM PT (the page header says “11.11 sale ends on Nov 15,” and the sale record the page loads ends at 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z, which is that PT instant). Sale checkout prices: Plus annual $35/mo billed yearly (list $59, −41%); Ultra 3K / 6K / 9K annual $65 / $110 / $150 per month billed yearly (list $129 / $258 / $387). Monthly first-month prices, then renewal at list: Plus $47 then $59 (20% off once); Ultra 3K $79 then $129 (40% off once); Ultra 6K $150 then $250 (40% off once); Ultra 9K $209 then $375 (45% off once). Business, shown per seat: Team annual $45/seat/mo billed yearly (list $79, −43%, 1,000 credits/seat); Team monthly $55/seat then listed as 30% off (list $79); Scale annual $80/seat/mo billed yearly (list $215, −63%, 2,500 credits/seat); Scale monthly $120/seat/mo (list $215, 45% off). Enterprise is custom. Prices exclude VAT and local taxes. Sources: higgsfield.ai/pricing (Individual Annual / Monthly and Business tabs, rendered Nov 13, 2026 PT), the public plans API and 11.11 sale record that page loads, and How do Higgsfield plans work?.

What do credits buy for the models we track?

The pricing-page compare table states a credits-per-clip figure for each listed model and resolution. Wan 3.0 is 5 / 8.75 / 17.5 credits per 5-second clip at 480p / 720p / 1080p; Wan 3.0 Prime is 7.5 / 15 / 30. Those figures have no tilde. Kling 3.0 is labeled “~7 / ~8 / ~30 credits/5s” at 720p / 1080p / 4K (the same table’s annual video counts divide to 7.5 and about 8.75 at 720p and 1080p; the catalog keeps those as estimates). Seedance 2.5 is 35 credits/5s at 720p and 80 credits/5s at 1080p. Google Veo 3.1 is “~16 credits/4s” (Fast) and “~40 credits/4s” (standard) at 720p and at 1080p. Minimax Hailuo 2.3 is “~6 / ~10 credits/6s” at 768p / 1080p, or “~4 / ~7” for Fast. Grok Video is “~7 credits/5s” and Grok Video Edit is “~10 credits/5s,” with no resolution on the label. Gemini Omni Flash and Runway Gen-4 do not appear on that compare table or on the API pricing index checked today, so this guide does not invent a Higgsfield credit cost for them. A 10-second clip is shown only where the official unit is 5 seconds and the catalog already prices by the second; Veo’s official unit is 4 seconds and Hailuo’s is 6 seconds, and a 10-second length is not published for those. Source: the Video category of the compare table on higgsfield.ai/pricing, from the compare API that page loads, checked Nov 13, 2026 PT.

How do Unlimited bonuses work, and where do they apply?

Higgsfield’s help article and the pricing-page footer both say Unlimited models and free generations are accessible only on higgsfield.ai, not on MCP/CLI, Canvas, or Supercomputer. Generations outside higgsfield.ai deduct credits. The toggle in the generation panel has to be on, or the run uses credits. Unlimited runs in the standard queue; credit runs are in the priority queue, and Unlimited speed may be adjusted in high traffic. Access is a one-time period that only works while the paid plan stays active. On today’s 11.11 cards, annual Plus includes 14 days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 at 30s and 720p; annual Ultra 3K/6K/9K includes 14 days at 30s and 1080p. Monthly Plus includes 7 days at 20s and 480p; monthly Ultra 3K includes 14 days at 20s and 720p. Starter lists no Seedance 2.5 unlimited window. Scale annual, after business verification, includes 30 days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 at 25s and 720p; Scale monthly includes 7 days at the same cap. Team’s unlimited video window is Seedance 2.0 (15s, 720p), not Seedance 2.5: 14 days on annual, 7 days on monthly, also after business verification. The page does not say when those day counts start. Sources: What are Unlimited models?, the pricing-page footer and plan cards on higgsfield.ai/pricing, and the 11.11 sale record the page loads, checked Nov 13, 2026 PT.

The same help article describes a longer “365 Unlimited” style of access on mid and top plans: generations on listed models do not deduct credits for a stated period, only while the paid plan stays active, and only on higgsfield.ai. Plus and Ultra cards also say “5 other unlimited models” without naming them on the card. This guide does not invent those five names or treat any Unlimited window as $0/s.

How promo prices work says a promo price applies to the first payment or the period stated in the offer, and that the plan then renews at the standard price. Monthly Plus and Ultra first-month cards already print the renewal list price. Annual cards and the plans API show the sale monthly-equivalent as the renew price (the API marks those annual discounts “forever”). It is not confirmed, from the annual cards alone, whether a new Ultra 9K annual $150/mo price remains after Nov 14, 2026, 4:00 PM PT.

What is confirmed, and what is not

Confirmed Nov 13, 2026 PT on Higgsfield’s own pages and the APIs those pages load: the individual and business list and 11.11 sale prices in the table above; credit allowances; the sale end instant 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z (Nov 14, 2026, 4:00 PM PT); Unlimited and free generations only on higgsfield.ai; the Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 window lengths and caps written on the cards; official credits-per-clip in the compare table; catalog Starter / Plus / Ultra 3K dollar amounts, which still match today’s checkout figures; Higgsfield API “from” list prices for Wan 3.0, Wan 3.0 Prime, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5.

Unknown: whether annual sale prices stay at $35 / $65 / $110 / $150 after the sale for new buyers, or for renewals, given the tension between the help article and the plans API; when the 7-, 14-, 30-, and 60-day Unlimited clocks start; the five unnamed “other” unlimited models on the Plus/Ultra cards; a published credit cost or Higgsfield plan $/s for Gemini Omni Flash or Runway Gen-4; the resolution of “Grok Video”; credit-pack list prices (the cards say top-ups exist, with a discount on paid plans, but this check did not capture a pack price table); a failed-generation refund rule for plan credits. Invented figures are not shown for those gaps.

How do we calculate this?

Each dollar figure is a current price row, with the vendor page and the date that page was checked. A published rate is a dollars-per-second figure on that page, or an API credit count times the credit price the page states. A credit-plan figure is plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and it assumes every credit you pay for is used. When the vendor marks that count with "~", "roughly", or "estimated", the row is labelled estimated from credit plan and is not a list price. A promo shows its end date when the vendor gave one. The full method is on the about page (https://vidfare.com/about/).
